publish-signing-keystore.title: Release keystore + signingConfigs + 双机备份 + 版本 bump 0.1.0
publish-signing-keystore.description:
密码方案：文件保存（与 keystore 同信任边界）。两边各持一份 ~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore.password (mode 600)，跟 .keystore 文件同步过去。

步骤：

[Agent] 1) mkdir -p ~/secrets/closepaw, chmod 700 ~/secrets/closepaw
[Agent] 2) openssl rand -base64 32 > ~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore.password, chmod 600 同文件
[Agent] 3) PASSWORD=$(cat ~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore.password); keytool -genkeypair -v -storetype PKCS12 -keystore ~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore -alias closepaw -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -storepass "$PASSWORD" -keypass "$PASSWORD" -dname "CN=ClosePaw,O=ClosePaw Authors,C=CN"; chmod 600 ~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore
[Agent] 4) ssh moonkey@laptop "mkdir -p ~/secrets/closepaw && chmod 700 ~/secrets/closepaw"
[Agent] 5) scp ~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore ~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore.password moonkey@laptop:~/secrets/closepaw/, ssh laptop "chmod 600 ~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore ~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore.password"
[Agent] 6) 校验两机 sha256 一致
[Agent] 7) 在 app/build.gradle.kts 加 signingConfigs，密码读 env：KEYSTORE_PATH/KEYSTORE_PASSWORD/KEY_ALIAS/KEY_PASSWORD
[Agent] 8) 把 versionCode/versionName 提到 gradle.properties，初值 versionName=0.1.0、versionCode=1
[Agent] 9) 确认 .gitignore 含 *.keystore *.jks（防误提交）
[Agent] 10) 写一个简单的 scripts/release-build.sh wrapper：从 ~/secrets/closepaw/ 读密码 export env 然后跑 ./gradlew assembleRelease
[Agent] 11) 跑 scripts/release-build.sh 验证 desktop 出签名 APK
[人 30 秒] 12) Laptop 上跑 scripts/release-build.sh 同样验证（你自己 ssh 进去跑一下确认跨机一致；agent 也能远程触发但你看一眼更稳）

⚠️ Keystore 一旦丢失 = app 身份永久丢失，所有用户必须卸载重装才能升级。双机备份是底线。考虑额外 USB/云盘 cold backup（可选）。
⚠️ 本任务只 setup 本地构建，不 push 任何东西到 GitHub。

详见 projects/active/1_publish/2_release_build_claude.md。
acceptCriteria: ~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore 存在 mode 600 in desktop 和 laptop
~/secrets/closepaw/release.keystore.password 存在 mode 600 in desktop 和 laptop
两机 keystore 文件 sha256 一致
两机 password 文件内容一致
grep -q signingConfigs app/build.gradle.kts
版本 0.1.0 写入 gradle.properties 或 app/build.gradle.kts
grep -qE "keystore|jks" .gitignore
test -x scripts/release-build.sh

Laptop scripts/release-build.sh 产出签名 APK，jarsigner -verify 通过

publish-r8-release-fix.title: Fix R8 release-build blockers (snakeyaml + Compose mapping)
publish-r8-release-fix.description:
publish-signing-keystore 验证签名链路时发现 assembleRelease 被两个**预存在**的 R8 问题挡住，必须修才能产出可分发的 release APK。

两个具体问题：
1. snakeyaml `java.beans.*` 缺 keep rules — 运行时 R8 strip 后反射失败。需要在 app/proguard-rules.pro 加 keep rules。snakeyaml 是间接依赖（看 ./gradlew :app:dependencies | grep snakeyaml 找哪个 lib 引入的）。
2. Compose mapping bug "major version 69" — 看 logcat / build trace 找具体 stack；可能是 Kotlin Compose plugin / Compose compiler 版本与 Gradle/AGP 不兼容，或者 R8 处理 metadata 失败。可能要 bump Compose compiler version、加 R8 keep rules、或某个 -dontwarn 规则。

排查方法：
- ./scripts/release-build.sh :app:assembleRelease --stacktrace 拿到完整异常
- 单独看 R8 missing rules report：app/build/outputs/mapping/release/missing_rules.txt
- 真机 install release APK 验功能（accessibility + LLM + Shizuku）

这是 R8 keep rule 调试任务，估计要试几轮。完成后 publish-release-workflow 才该实际触发首次 tag push。
acceptCriteria: ./scripts/release-build.sh :app:assembleRelease 跑完无 R8 异常
app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk 产出
jarsigner -verify -verbose app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk 通过
真机 install release APK，启动后 accessibility + LLM + Shizuku 功能正常
publish-r8-release-fix.note: Done at 9a524d15. Three root causes found: (1) snakeyaml 2.2 (direct dep used by SkillFrontmatterParser) calls java.beans.* — added -dontwarn + -keep rules; (2) bcprov-jdk18on:1.84 multi-release jar ships Java 25 bytecode that Kotlin 2.3.0 ASM in produceReleaseComposeMapping cannot parse — disabled the optional Compose mapping pipeline (debug-only metadata); (3) R8 OOMd at 2g — bumped org.gradle.jvmargs to 4g. Verified: clean assembleRelease green, 140MB APK, apksigner v2 cert SHA-256 841375c9...c3fd matches signing keystore. Note: jarsigner -verify expectedly fails (v2-only signing for minSdk=31), apksigner is the modern check.
